title: Year 8, 2026 Week 9 Matchup Previews
subtitle: With six playoff spots, the model highlights very different levels of Week 9 urgency.

playoffModel.description: Seeded Monte Carlo estimate using current record, scoring strength and remaining Sleeper schedule.

matchups.headline: Payton’s cushion meets CJ’s pressure point
matchups.paragraph: Payton’s I ♥️ Big Tet-Tees enters ranked fourth at 5-3, with a 95.6% modeled playoff chance. A win raises that figure to 98.7%, while a loss drops it to 90.3%, an 8.4-point swing. CJ’s cjbroadway23 is fifth at 4-4 and carries a 64.7% chance, but the outcome matters far more: victory lifts the model to 82.5%, while defeat lowers it to 54.5%. Payton, a two-time champion, has more cushion; CJ has the sharper immediate incentive.

matchups.headline: Andy looks to protect a strong position
matchups.paragraph: Andy’s Long dong silvers are third at 6-2, backed by a 76.7% modeled playoff chance. The model gives Andy an 86% chance with a win and 58.9% with a loss, a 27.1-point swing despite the winning record. Brae’s Ogles Outlaws are 12th at 0-8, and the model assigns a 0% playoff chance before, after, or regardless of this result. That leaves Andy playing to strengthen an already favorable position, while Brae’s supplied playoff outlook does not change with the matchup.

matchups.headline: Kane and Cooper face sharply different margins
matchups.paragraph: Kane’s Blueballs sit sixth at 4-4, holding a 68.3% modeled playoff chance in a six-spot field. A win moves Kane to 75.5%, while a loss drops the chance to 47.3%, producing a 28.2-point swing. Cooper’s Jack MeHoff is 11th at 2-6, with only a 0.1% chance; the model reaches 0.4% with a win and 0% with a loss. Cooper’s team also carries 2022 championship history, but the current numbers make Kane’s playoff position the central stake.

matchups.headline: Kade needs movement against an almost-locked Evan
matchups.paragraph: Kade’s CheesusJesus is eighth at 4-4, with a 23.4% modeled playoff chance. A win would lift Kade’s figure to 42.4%, while a loss lowers it to 17.9%, a 24.5-point swing. Evan’s first-place Bonnie Blue 42 is 7-1 and modeled at 100%, with the estimate staying at 100% after a win and 99.9% after a loss. Evan, the 2023 champion, therefore faces minimal modeled playoff movement, while Kade has a meaningful chance to improve a volatile position.

matchups.headline: Parker and Kohlt meet with room to climb
matchups.paragraph: Parker’s My BallDak hurts ranks ninth at 3-5 and has a 41.6% modeled playoff chance. A win raises that number to 51.1%; a loss lowers it to 21.4%, a 29.7-point swing. Kohlt’s team is also 3-5 but ranks 10th, with a 6.7% chance. The model gives Kohlt a 16% chance with a win and 2.4% with a loss, a 13.6-point swing. Parker’s championship history and league lore aside, both managers need a result to improve their outlook.

matchups.headline: Joey needs a lift against reigning champion Alex
matchups.paragraph: Joey’s Off Constantly is seventh at 4-4, but the model gives it only a 23% playoff chance. A win raises Joey’s figure to 39.7%, while a loss reduces it to 16.6%, a 23.1-point swing. Alex’s I love big TD’s is second at 6-2, with a 99.9% chance; the estimate reaches 100% with a win and falls to 99.5% with a loss. The matchup pits Joey’s meaningful climb against Alex’s very stable position as the 2025 champion.
